definitions.explanation: A tool or weapon made from stone, typically associated with prehistoric periods.

examples.japanese: {石器|せっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{旧石器|きゅうせっき}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{石器|せっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Stone tools from the Paleolithic period were found.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{縄文|じょうもん}{時代|じだい}→縄文時代：18895_joumonjidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{石器|せっき}や⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The museum displays many stone tools and pottery from the Jomon period.

notes:
A compound of {石|せき} (stone) and {器|き} (tool, vessel). A fundamental term in history and archaeology.

ETYMOLOGY:
Japan's prehistoric periods are defined partly by stone tool technology. The {旧石器|きゅうせっき}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (Paleolithic, before ~14,000 BCE) used chipped stone tools, while the {新石器|しんせっき}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (Neolithic) introduced polished stone tools alongside pottery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石器|せっき}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ — Stone Age
- {旧石器|きゅうせっき}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ — Paleolithic (Old Stone Age)
- {新石器|しんせっき}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ — Neolithic (New Stone Age)
- {打製|だせい}{石器|せっき} — chipped stone tool
- {磨製|ませい}{石器|せっき} — polished stone tool

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧ — earthenware, pottery; another key artifact type
- {青銅器|せいどうき} — bronze ware; the next technological stage
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧ — archaeological site; where stone tools are found
